items.html: Know that each and every letter of these four letters of the Name HaVaYaH mentioned above is divided into ten. And these are the aspects of those four letters mentioned in the Zohar, in Parashat Tetzaveh and in Parashat Beresheet, in the manuscripts (Ketav Yad), in the secret of those supports (Samchin) that each and every letter of these four has. Understand this, and remember it. And these ten supports that each and every letter of these four has — they are divided into the ten Sefirot within each and every garment of these three garments of the Nukva of ZA. And know that these ten aforementioned supports are clothed in the ten Sefirot of the Nukva in each world of the three worlds BYA, as above.
